'''Protector X LEO armor''' was a model of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that was produced by the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]]. The armor was constructed similarly to [[Capari-series padded beast armor]] created by [[Piccatech Ltd.]].<ref name="Stay on Target" />
